Now I can see the problem! The CSS is set up for a **3-column grid**:

```css
.models-split-view {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1px 1fr;  /* Left pane | Divider | Right pane */
}
```

And there's a CSS rule for the divider:

```css
.models-split-view > :nth-child(2) {
    background-color: var(--border-color);
    width: 1px;
}
```

**But the code only has 2 children** (left and right panes), not 3. The second child (the divider element) is missing!

Looking at the code in `SettingsDialogModelsTab.js`, lines 51-409:

```jsx
<div className="models-split-view">
  <div className="models-pane left">...</div>
  {/* No divider here! */}
  <div className="models-pane right">...</div>
</div>
```

The structure should have **three children** to match the grid:
1. Left pane
2. **Divider element** (empty div)
3. Right pane

This is why the right side is not showing correctly — the grid has a 1px middle column that's being skipped, causing layout issues.

Let me fix this by adding the missing divider element:

---

Incorrect tool arguments

---

Let me add the missing divider element. I need to be more precise with the text replacement:

---

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="edit_file_v2">

<details><summary>Tool use: **edit_file_v2** • Edit file: /home/wsj/src/T-R/src/renderer/components/SettingsDialogModelsTab.js</summary>

</details>

</tool-use>

---

Perfect! I've identified and fixed the issue. The problem was that the `models-split-view` grid container is configured to have **3 columns** (`1fr 1px 1fr`), expecting:

1. Left pane (1 fraction unit)
2. **Divider** (1px width)
3. Right pane (1 fraction unit)

**But the JSX was missing the divider element**, so the grid was incorrectly placing the right pane in the middle column, offsetting the layout.

## The Fix

I added the missing divider element between the two panes:

```jsx
<div className="models-split-view">
  <div className="models-pane left">...</div>
  
  {/* Vertical Divider */}
  <div className="models-divider"></div>
  
  <div className="models-pane right">...</div>
</div>
```

The CSS already had the proper styling for the divider:

```css
.models-split-view > :nth-child(2) {
    background-color: var(--border-color);
    width: 1px;
}
```

Now both panes should be visible correctly with a 1px border between them. The layout will work as intended!

Done! I've updated the `ModelSelector` component:

**Changes made:**

1. **Added sorting**: Models are now sorted alphabetically by their display name using `localeCompare()`.

2. **Show provider in parentheses**: The dropdown now displays models as `Model Name (provider)`. For example: `Claude 3.5 Sonnet (anthropic)` or `GPT-4 (openai)`.

The updated component:
- Creates a `getModelInfo()` helper that extracts both the name and provider from the model ID (format: `provider/model-name`)
- Sorts the models array by name before rendering
- Displays each option as `name (provider)` when a provider exists

Now the model select box on the translate/rewrite page will show a sorted list with provider information clearly visible.
